method: R1 blind suread (subagent read text only, no md/rules)

facts.fact: Hattie凌晨三点半回到家，完全不记得自己是怎么开的车。
facts.anchor: It’s half past three in the morning when she gets home.

facts.fact: Hattie想起Tommy审判期间她读的一篇报道中那则从那时起一直留在心里的评论。
facts.anchor: During Tommy’s trial she’d made the mistake of reading an article covering the proceedings

facts.fact: Hattie走到书房，望向海湾对面Sloan的家，那里仍亮着几盏灯，像灯塔一样召唤她。
facts.anchor: looks across the bay to Sloan’s. A few lights are still burning there.

facts.fact: Hattie拿钥匙准备出门时，她的旧电话响了。
Hattie从抽屉里取出旧电话，看着屏幕上熟悉的号码，在铃声停止前接了起来。
facts.anchor: Before the ringing can end, she answers.

facts.fact: Hattie说自己八年来一直活在Tommy造成的破坏和她自身罪疚的阴影里。
facts.anchor: She’s lived for eight years in the shadow of his destruction and her own guilt.

facts.fact: Hattie终于对电话那头发问“你是谁？”
对方轻轻吸了一口气，随即挂断了电话。
facts.anchor: There’s a quiet inhale, then the line goes dead.
